relationships.name: items
relationships.expression: relationship('InvoiceItem', back_populates='invoice', cascade='all, delete-orphan', order_by='InvoiceItem.position', lazy='selectin')

relationships.name: payments
relationships.expression: relationship('InvoicePayment', back_populates='invoice', cascade='all, delete-orphan', order_by='InvoicePayment.id.desc()', lazy='selectin')

relationships.name: events
relationships.expression: relationship('InvoiceEvent', back_populates='invoice', cascade='all, delete-orphan', order_by='InvoiceEvent.id.desc()', lazy='selectin')
